sensory-friendly mass invitation st colmcille’s parish (ballyhackamore belfast bt4 3jb) warmly invites you to our monthly sensory mass on saturday, 31st october at 12:00 noon. this special mass is designed to be inclusive and welcoming for individuals and families who may benefit from a quieter, more relaxed worship environment. the short mass will feature: gentle lighting and sound; a calm and supportive atmosphere; space to move around if needed; sensory items to regulation; a warm welcome for all ages and abilities. whether you or a loved one experience sensory sensitivities, or you simply wish to attend a short peaceful and reflective service, we would love to see you there. refreshments after mass. pips charity is a regional northern ireland charity dedicated to suicide prevention, supporting mental health and emotional wellbeing. with offices in belfast, derry and enniskillen, we p rovide a range of free support services, such as crisis intervention, counselling, and befriending, to individuals and families affected by suicidal thoughts, emotional distress, mental health difficulties, and bereavement. we would particularly like to bring your attention to our weekend crisis hopeline, a regional overnight telephone service available friday and sunday nights, to anyone across northern ireland experiencing emotional distress, suicidal thoughts, or a mental health crisis. the operational hours for the weekend crisis hopeline are as follows. friday: 9pm - 10am saturday sunday: 9pm - 9am monday

| freephone 0800 088 6042 we know that crisis doesn't wait for working hours. the weekend crisis hopeline provides a confidential, non-judgemental space to talk with a trained crisis practitioner when someone is in distress, needs support or simply wants someone to talk to during a difficult time outside of working hours. there is no referral process for the hopeline, and individuals can contact us directly whenever they feel in need of support. for more information, please feel free to refer to our website where the information on the weekend crisis hopeline is posted: weekend crisis hopeline - pips suicide prevention ireland
